internship.title: The interface is only one part of the system.
internship.copy: An expanding interest in how people form expectations, make decisions, and interpret feedback informs the technical work. It is why usability, satisfaction, and understandable outputs recur across otherwise different projects.

target.copy: In the early 48-person questionnaire sample, residents reported only moderate familiarity with nearby stores and amenities. That observation motivated a neighborhood-access map organized around nearby facilities and walking time.

ticket.copy: The project extended beyond the map. One intervention addressed food-safety misconceptions about leftovers; another focused on recognizing fraud and protecting property. Some participants later described the anti-fraud lecture as informative and said it clarified information they had been unsure about.

draft.title: The mechanism moved beyond course allocation.
draft.copy: Presented the project at the National Round of China Thinks Big. Discussions focused on possible applications and the need for real-world preference data. The framework was later deployed for a class-wide parent–teacher meeting. It reduced manual planning, balanced attendance across time slots, and kept adjusted appointments close to parent preferences.
